title: Best Things to Do in Boone NC This Weekend
excerpt: Summer weekends in Boone, NC are alive with outdoor adventure, local events, and the kind of mountain energy that makes people fall in love with the High Country. If you've ever thought about owning a piece of this place, there's no better time to come see it for yourself.
